findings.summary: U4 pin INT2 (LSM_TRG) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin INT2 on U4 (LSM6DSV16XTR) is connected to net LSM_TRG but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from LSM_TRG to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin INT2 is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
